title: The GUI should be better.  A lot better.
summary: Accursed Farms' hour-plus critique of the modern desktop GUI. It argues that current interfaces are a regression from older designs such as Windows 7 and proposes principles for better ones.
why: Recommended as a thought-provoking critique that makes people notice how poor everyday GUIs are.

quote.text: this video cursed me to pay far more attention on how shitty modern GUI is in my everyday interaction with the computer and phone
